_meta.purpose: Registry of every artifact produced for this product. Read before producing a new artifact to check whether it already exists; updated by the post-artifact-created hook on every artifact write.
_meta.how_to_use: 1. Look up an artifact by id or type before creating a new one. 2. Check status before treating an entry as current — superseded entries are historical only. 3. Follow traces_to to find the requirement, decision, or event behind any artifact.
_meta.updated_by: <decision id or event that produced this manifest, e.g. the /sdlc-start run that created this product>
